title: The deadline record a managed VM carries in its own Hyper-V Notes (allocator.md, Host power-off backstop)
x-owner: P10.6 (Windows provider) and P11.3 (Linux provider) write it before the VM's first start; P10.7 (host watchdog) reads it; consumers P12.3, P02.1
description: One compact ASCII JSON object in the VM's Notes, under 1 KiB, no secret and no path. deadline_utc is started_utc plus the 6 hour ceiling exactly, never the configured cap. check is the first 32 hex of the SHA-256 of 'aap-vm-cap:1|' and vm_id, vm_name, reservation_id, started_utc and deadline_utc joined by '|' (validate.py notes_check): it detects truncation and hand edits and is no secret. The watchdog acts only when every identity rule of allocator.md B3 holds.
